title: mw.notify.opt-out.v1
description: A promotional opt-out (ticket 111, FRS NOT-09). mw-app-gateway publishes it for POST /app/v1/notifications/opt-out; mw-notify (the consumer, so the owner) records the MSISDN hash and honours it for PROMO only. OTP and transactional messages are never opted out. Key: walletId. Consumers ignore unknown fields; only additive changes within v1.

walletId.description: The core's wallet id (the MSISDN for app wallets), from the caller's token.

channel.description: Where the opt-out was asked. Absent is APP.
